stories.title: Ferry carrying nearly 270 people capsizes off northern Cyprus, at least 7 dead
stories.reason: The Filo Jet capsized in rough weather en route from Kyrenia to Turkey; 237 were rescued but roughly two dozen remain missing, and police have detained the captain and seven others.

stories.title: Iceland rejects reopening EU accession talks in close referendum
stories.reason: A narrow 52.8%-47.2% 'No' vote, on 82.5% turnout, keeps Iceland out of EU membership talks for now, even as the government had argued renewed talks could help counter Arctic security and economic pressures.

stories.title: OpenAI to cut off Cursor's model access after SpaceX's $60 billion acquisition
stories.reason: OpenAI says it can't trust Musk's companies to honor its terms of service, escalating the Altman-Musk feud and pushing Cursor toward Anthropic's Claude models instead.

stories.title: September Fed rate decision now a 'coin flip' after Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole signals
stories.reason: Odds of a September hike have surged since Warsh's speech, with 2-year Treasury yields hitting their highest since late July as Iran-linked oil price shocks complicate the inflation fight.

stories.title: Nvidia in talks to invest in Perplexity at over $30 billion valuation
stories.reason: The deal would value Perplexity 50% higher than a year ago as its annualized revenue triples to $750 million, deepening Nvidia's circular pattern of funding the AI startups that buy its chips.

stories.title: SoftBank plans record $6.3 billion retail bond to help fund its OpenAI stake
stories.reason: The biggest retail bond ever issued by a Japanese company shows how much debt SoftBank is taking on to keep funding its roughly $30 billion in additional OpenAI commitments.

stories.title: Pew: 34% of US adults now use AI chatbots for health information
stories.reason: Chatbots have quietly become a mainstream health resource for a third of Americans, even though fewer than a third say they're comfortable sharing personal health data with them.

stories.title: Andreessen Horowitz raises $1.1 billion 'Machine Age' fund for AI hardware
stories.reason: The fund targets chips, power, cooling and robotics as AI data-center racks race toward a projected 1 megawatt of draw within three years, a sign the industry's bottleneck is shifting from models to physical infrastructure.
